description: This Java class 'JWTValidator' provides functionality to validate JWT tokens using Nimbus JOSE+JWT library, including setting expected audience, matching claims, required claims, and processing JWTs with verification.

classes.name: JWTValidator
classes.description: A class for validating JWT tokens with configurable audience, claims, and algorithms, using Nimbus JOSE+JWT library.

methods.name: JWTValidator
methods.description: Constructor initializing JWTProcessor with a JWK source and setting a JOSE object type verifier.

methods.name: withExpectedAudience
methods.description: Sets the expected audience for JWT validation.

methods.name: withMatchingClaims
methods.description: Sets claims that must match during validation.

methods.name: withRequiredClaims
methods.description: Sets claims that are required to be present in the JWT.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a JWT string and returns its claims set if valid, throws AuthenticationException if invalid.
